name: Deutero-Isaiah
major_ideas: Exclusive monotheism as a historical innovation
biography: Identified by Russell as the author of the second half of the Book of Isaiah, 'the most remarkable of the prophets,' the first to have the Lord declare 'There is no god but I,' and the source of the messianic texts later used by Christians as prophecies of Christ.
central_doctrines: Exclusive monotheism as a historical innovation: The doctrine, first fully articulated by prophets such as Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Deutero-Isaiah, that Yahweh alone is God, that other gods either do not exist or are false, and that their worship is punishable sin -- as opposed to earlier practice in which Yahweh was one tribal god among others.
